chunks: Prostration on the earth is obligatory, and on other than that is sunnah (a recommended practice).

key_terms.الْأَرْضِ: the earth or ground as the proper surface for prostration

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about performing sajdah on the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the proper material for sajdah (prostration). It establishes prostration on the earth as obligatory and describes prostration on other than that as sunnah, indicating a juristic distinction in the manner of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.828 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Prostration (Sujood) on the earth is obligatory (fardh), while prostrating on other than that is a recommended practice (sunnah)."
